subject: Third-party dependency control catalog and SOC 2 crosswalk
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika.shah@aureliahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurelia Health Security Team <security@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: control catalog + SOC 2 crosswalk for procurement review

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this procurement request. Our security and procurement teams are moving forward on the infra selection for our clinical operations workload and we need two bundled items to complete our review: 1) a third-party control catalog listing all subprocessors, hosted locations (region/residency), and high-level controls they cover, and 2) a SOC 2 / SIG-lite crosswalk — we want to see which SOC 2 sections map to the SIG questions you answered.

Target timeline: can you provide a draft by end of day Monday (US PST)?

A couple of small asks: please flag any processors that handle ephemeral secrets or KMS keys, and indicate whether any subprocessors are onshore-only. Also call out any known exceptions (retention, telemetry access).

Thanks,
Anika Shah
Senior Information Security Manager
Aurelia Health

Attachment: procurement-template.xlsx (requested fields)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika.shah@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: control catalog + SOC 2 crosswalk for procurement review

Hi Anika — thanks for the clear asks. We can do a crosswalk and supply a control catalog. I'll coordinate the evidence pulls and get you a draft pack by Monday.

Plan:
- Ben will pull the subprocessor roster and residency matrix and export a control coverage CSV.
- Marissa will assemble the SIG-lite crosswalk and flag any attestation notes.
- Naomi will confirm KMS/residency details and provide the key custody summary.

One question: for the SOC 2 crosswalk do you prefer mapping at the section level (CC1–CC8 / Common Criteria) or at the illustrative criteria level? We can do both, but the section-level will be faster.

Deliverables (Monday draft): control-catalog CSV, SIG-lite crosswalk (PDF), and a short readme with open items. Finalized pack by next Friday if that works for you.

Soojin Lee
Head of Security Compliance, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments referenced: procurement-template.xlsx (from Aurelia), will upload our drafts to shared Drive link when ready.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: control catalog + SOC 2 crosswalk for procurement review

On Fri, Apr 16, 2027 at 11:03 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Plan:
> - Ben will pull the subprocessor roster and residency matrix and export a control coverage CSV.

I've kicked off the roster export and a first-pass control mapping against our internal control IDs. Estimated ETA for the CSV: Monday 09:00 PT. I'll include a residency column and a KMS-handles-secrets boolean for quick filtering.

Questions for the Aurelia ask: 1) do they need artifact-level proof (S3 paths / certificates) in the first draft or just the roster + crosswalk? 2) any party-specific NDAs that would restrict sharing particular artifacts?

I'll attach my raw CSV and a short notes tab.

Ben Carter
Vendor Risk Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment (to internal thread): redwood_control-catalog_v1.csv (working)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: control catalog + SOC 2 crosswalk for procurement review

Ben — thanks for the export. I'm attaching a draft SIG-lite crosswalk (PDF) that maps the SIG sections Aurelia is likely to ask about to our SOC 2 report sections. I added commentary where our SOC 2 report references are high-level (we can push artifact links later if they want to review).

Naomi, I've put a KMS tab in Ben's CSV and marked the three providers who handle key material. Please confirm residency claims for those entries — I noted one provider as EU-resident but with onshore replication options.

Soojin — will you / I send the draft bundle to Anika, or do you prefer I do the initial external send and frame the open items?

Marissa Cole
Security Controls & Assessments
Redwood Inference

Attachments (internal): sig-lite-crosswalk_draft.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika.shah@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: control catalog + SOC 2 crosswalk for procurement review

Anika — attaching the draft bundle for your team to review. This is intended to satisfy the procurement checklist you sent; below are the open items and suggested next steps.

Attachments:
- redwood_control-catalog_v1.csv (subprocessor roster, residency, control coverage, KMS flag)
- sig-lite-crosswalk_draft.pdf (SIG-to-SOC2 crosswalk with notes)
- kms-residency-matrix.xlsx (KMS custody & residency details)

Open items we flagged:
1) Artifact requests: we included SOC 2 report citations and page ranges. If Aurelia needs artifact-level proof (hosted S3 paths or specific cert bundles), we'll need a signed NDA and limited access.
2) Residency confirmation: Provider "AtlasKey" is EU-primary with onshore replication; Aurelia should confirm whether replicated residency meets your residency requirement.
3) Telemetry retention: one subprocessor retains metrics for 14 days — we've flagged it as an exception for your review.

Suggested next steps:
- Let us know if you want the artifact pack (we can deliver via secure share + time-limited links).
- If Aurelia wants a short walkthrough, Marissa and I can do a 30-minute session next week to explain the crosswalk and the open items.

Thanks — look forward to your feedback.

Soojin Lee
Head of Security Compliance
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
